blockers.missing_evidence: Authorized acquisition evidence for the exact English ISO/IEC 42001:2023 PDF, including final URL, filename, byte length, SHA-256, PDF metadata, page count, and acquisition time.
blockers.owner: ESAF Project Maintainer and authorized ISO/IEC 42001 source custodian
blockers.reconsideration_trigger: An authorized person acquires the exact artifact through the intended ISO/IEC commercial flow without placing protected bytes in the repository.
blockers.reentry_test: The source oracle records the authorized artifact as available and every required identity, byte, digest, metadata, page-count, and acquisition field is non-null and independently verified.

blockers.missing_evidence: Case-specific written ISO/IEC permission, or equivalent licensing, for the exact ESAF field classes, repository, website, generated publications, project license, and downstream redistribution model.
blockers.owner: ESAF Project Maintainer and ISO/IEC permissions contact
blockers.reconsideration_trigger: ISO/IEC grants written permission covering the complete proposed publication use.
blockers.reentry_test: An independent rights reviewer verifies the executed permission against every proposed field class and publication channel and records an attributable PASS disposition.

blockers.missing_evidence: An independently reconciled complete inventory of the authorized publishable ISO/IEC 42001:2023 clauses or control outcomes, with count and digest.
blockers.owner: ESAF Project Maintainer and independent inventory authors
blockers.reconsideration_trigger: Authorized source access and publication permission allow two independent inventories at the approved granularity.
blockers.reentry_test: Independent inventories reconcile to one complete population, and tests reproduce the exact provision count and canonical inventory digest.

blockers.missing_evidence: A positive feasibility probe for the exact directional question using authorized ISO/IEC 42001:2023 outcomes and exact normative ESAF requirements.
blockers.owner: ESAF Project Maintainer and qualified mapper
blockers.reconsideration_trigger: The authorized source artifact, publication rights, and complete reconciled provision inventory are available.
blockers.reentry_test: A qualified mapper and independent reviewers record at least one evidence-backed positive probe for the exact question while preserving all ESAF-1600 negative and overclaiming rules.

blockers.missing_evidence: Named qualified people with authorized source access for the mapper, ISO/IEC 42001 subject-matter, ESAF specification and mapping, publication-rights, security and overclaiming, and owner-authorized approval roles.
blockers.owner: ESAF Project Maintainer and review coordinator
blockers.reconsideration_trigger: Qualified named people accept the closed role, independence, access-attestation, exact-candidate, and findings-disposition contract.
blockers.reentry_test: The readiness evidence names every required person, verifies qualifications and independence, and proves attributable exact-SHA inventory/specification and security/overclaiming reviews with no open Critical or Important findings.

gates.rationale: Pinned public bibliographic identity identifies ISO/IEC 42001:2023 and records official discovery URLs without retaining protected source bytes.
The protected normative PDF bytes, source SHA-256, page count, and acquisition evidence are unavailable.
The independent rights review records HOLD because no case-specific written permission covers ESAF publication and redistribution.
No authorized exact source or independently reconciled complete provision population exists, and structural inventory remains prohibited.
Exact ISO/IEC 42001:2023 outcomes cannot be compared with normative ESAF requirements without authorized source access and a complete approved inventory.
Existing ESAF-1600 direction, relationship, negative-disposition, rights, evidence, and lifecycle controls can represent the proposed future mapping without a parallel schema.
Named qualified people with authorized source access and the required independent exact-candidate review roles are not evidenced.
The HOLD boundary, explicit nonclaims, exact directional question, and future independent security review requirements can be enforced mechanically.

mapping_contract.directional_question: Does exact normative ESAF control requirement text directly support, partially support, or establish a prerequisite for the outcome required by one authorized, publishable ISO/IEC 42001:2023 clause or control outcome, with each relationship's conditions, expected evidence, and known gaps recorded independently, without implying ISO/IEC 42001 compliance, assessment, equivalence, certification, authorization, or endorsement?

nonclaims: No protected ISO/IEC 42001:2023 source bytes were downloaded, accepted, or committed by this workstream.
No ISO/IEC 42001:2023 clause or control identifier, title, source text, close paraphrase, or structural inventory is published.
No ISO/IEC 42001:2023 provision inventory, provision count, or inventory digest exists.
No ISO/IEC 42001 mapping relationship, negative disposition, snapshot, lifecycle record, registry record, or generated catalog entry exists.
No ISO or IEC authorization, validation, approval, endorsement, or certification is claimed.
No ISO/IEC 42001 assessment, compliance, equivalence, coverage, or legal sufficiency is claimed.
No coverage statistic or percentage is calculated.
No decision is made for the excluded external_to_esaf direction.
reconsideration_sequence: Obtain case-specific written ISO/IEC permission, or equivalent licensing, for the exact publication and redistribution model.
Have an authorized person acquire and independently identify the exact English ISO/IEC 42001:2023 source artifact.
Create and reconcile a complete provision inventory at the authorized publishable granularity.
Name the qualified mapper, independent reviewers, review coordinator, and owner-authorized approver with required access attestations.
Refresh source identity and drift evidence, run the exact feasibility probe, and derive GO only if every gate passes with no blockers or open Critical or Important findings.

reviewer_contract.approver: An approver authorized by the ESAF project owner

reviewers.qualification: independent ESAF specification and mapping reviewer
